mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_order ( account_id, stock_code, transaction_type, order_type, quantity, order_price, status, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{transactionType}, #{orderType}, #{quantity}, #{orderPrice}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} FROM stock s WHERE s.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND s.active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, s.stock_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.trade_quantity), 0) as executedQuantity, (o.quantity - COALESCE(SUM(t.trade_quantity), 0)) as remainedQuantity FROM stock_order o JOIN stock s ON o.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN trade_log t ON o.order_id = t.order_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.status IN ('WAIT', 'PARTIAL') GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT o.stock_code FROM stock_order o JOIN stock s ON s.stock_code = o.stock_code AND s.active = 1 WHERE o.status IN ('WAIT', 'PARTIAL') AND o.quantity > COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(t.trade_quantity) FROM trade_log t WHERE t.order_id = o.order_id ), 0) ORDER BY o.stock_code
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_order SET order_price = #{orderPrice}, quantity = #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'WAIT' AND account_id = #{accountId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock s WHERE s.stock_code = stock_order.stock_code AND s.active = 1)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.*, s.stock_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.trade_quantity), 0) as executedQuantity FROM stock_order o JOIN stock s ON o.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN trade_log t ON o.order_id = t.order_id WHERE o.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND s.active = 1 AND o.status IN ('WAIT', 'PARTIAL') AND o.transaction_type = #{transactionType} AND ( o.order_type = 'MARKET' OR (o.transaction_type = 'BUY' AND o.order_price >= #{currentPrice}) OR (o.transaction_type = 'SELL' AND o.order_price <= #{currentPrice}) ) GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.created_at ASC, o.order_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_order SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('WAIT', 'PARTIAL')
UPDATE stock_order SET status = 'CANCEL' WHERE status IN ('WAIT', 'PARTIAL')
